name: routing_v7
instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific issue is the customer writing about? Pick the closest issue.

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment or purchase on the account that the customer did not make or does not recognise
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal the customer did not make or does not recognise, including a withdrawal showing in the app for cash they never received
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer does not recognise or did not set up (even if they ask for a refund or to dispute it)
criteria.unknown_money_or_charge: An unknown charge or money the customer didn't put there, suspicious activity, or someone else using the account
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card lost or stolen, reporting it, freezing it, or what to do now
criteria.compromised_card: Card details may be compromised, card used by someone else, worry about card security
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost or stolen, or the customer doesn't know where their phone is
criteria.pin_blocked_or_changed: PIN blocked, forgotten (can't remember it), wrong PIN attempts, how or where to change or reset the PIN
criteria.passcode_or_login: Forgotten app passcode, can't log in, locked out of the app
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept / swallowed / took the customer's card
criteria.charged_twice: The same payment or transaction charged twice / duplicated
criteria.request_refund: Wants a refund from a merchant, cancel an order, changed mind on an item, how to get money back for a purchase, how to dispute a transaction
criteria.refund_not_showing: A refund the customer was promised has not appeared in the account
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: ATM gave less or wrong amount of cash than requested
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate: The exchange rate applied to a purchase or ATM withdrawal abroad was wrong or worse than expected; an exchange cost too much
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An extra, unexplained charge or fee on the statement or in the app that the customer asks about ('what is this extra fee on my statement?', 'why was I charged extra?', a 1 pound charge in error), not tied by the customer to a specific ATM withdrawal, transfer, card payment, top-up or exchange
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A payment was cancelled, reverted or returned (including 'payments to my card were cancelled'), or a payment the customer made has disappeared / they can't find it
criteria.activate_card: How to activate a new card
criteria.card_arrival: Card ordered but has not arrived yet, tracking the card delivery
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, delivery on a date, getting a card sent / delivered to a given country, express delivery
criteria.card_linking: Adding / linking a card in the app, making a card show up in the app, found a lost card and wants to reactivate it
criteria.card_not_working: Card not working, stopped working, broken or damaged card
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Visa or Mastercard: which one the customer gets, choosing which card or card type they can have, can I use or get a Visa or Mastercard
criteria.card_expiry: Card about to expire, renewing an expiring card
criteria.disposable_virtual_card: Disposable virtual cards: getting one, limits on how many or how often they can be used
criteria.virtual_card: Getting a virtual card, or a virtual card not working
criteria.spare_or_physical_card: Ordering a physical card, a new or additional / spare card, replacement card cost, card fees for getting cards
criteria.first_pin: Where is my PIN, can't find the PIN, getting the PIN for a new card (not a forgotten or blocked PIN)
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs the card can be used at, ATM availability
criteria.apple_google_pay: Apple Pay or Google Pay, including topping up with them
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment was declined or rejected, card not accepted at a shop or online
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is still pending or taking long to go through (a payment, not a bank transfer)
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: ATM declined the cash withdrawal, couldn't get cash out
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is still pending, or the balance looks wrong after an ATM withdrawal
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted, can I use the card at a merchant
criteria.top_up_how: How to top up the account by card, cash, cheque, or bank transfer; where to top up
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed or was declined
criteria.top_up_pending: A top-up is pending or the topped-up money hasn't appeared
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted or cancelled
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account, receiving money or a salary (including in another currency)
criteria.transfer_pending_or_timing: A transfer is pending, how long transfers take, when it will arrive
criteria.transfer_failed_or_declined: A transfer failed or was declined
criteria.cancel_transfer: The customer wants to cancel, revert or undo a transfer or transaction they sent themselves, made a wrong transfer, or paid the wrong account (not cancelling a shop order or purchase)
criteria.transfer_not_received: Recipient has not received the transfer
criteria.balance_not_updated: Balance not updated after money came in: a bank transfer, cheque, or cash deposit
criteria.payment_methods: General questions about sending payments or transfers, SWIFT, payment types
criteria.card_payment_fee: A fee charged on a card payment or purchase ('I was charged a fee when I paid / bought something', 'my transaction went through but I was charged a fee')
criteria.cash_withdrawal_fee: A fee charged for an ATM cash withdrawal
criteria.transfer_fee: A fee charged on a transfer, or whether there are charges for sending or receiving money
criteria.top_up_fee: A fee for topping up by card or bank transfer
criteria.exchange_rate_info: What exchange rates are, how they are calculated
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app
criteria.unexpected_fees: Unexpected fees linked to spending or travelling abroad, foreign transactions or currency exchange
criteria.currency_support: Which currencies can be held or exchanged
criteria.supported_top_up_cards: Which cards or currencies can be used to top up or fund the account (e.g. American Express, a credit card); only when about topping up or funding
criteria.verify_identity: Identity verification: what documents are needed, how to verify
criteria.verification_failing: Identity verification not working, app cannot recognise the customer
criteria.source_of_funds: Source of funds checks; where did this money come from, who is sending or giving me money
criteria.close_account: Close, delete or terminate the account
criteria.country_support: Which countries the bank operates in / supports; whether customers in or from a given country can sign up or get a card
criteria.verify_top_up: Top-up verification code, verifying the card used for a top-up
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: A transfer or beneficiary is not allowed or not possible (e.g. 'my transfer was not allowed', can't add a beneficiary); not for declined or failed transfers
